userStories.title: scripts/verifier.py — onchain position validator
userStories.description:
Current state: data/positions.json (open positions), data/trade_log.jsonl (history), BASE_WALLET in .env.

Build scripts/verifier.py:
- sys.path.insert(0, '.') for scanner imports
- Read data/positions.json, data/trade_log.jsonl
- For each position: query Basescan API (module=account&action=tokenbalance)
- Compare onchain balance vs logged amount_usd/entry_price
- Log to data/verifier_log.jsonl (append): {"ts": "iso", "symbol": "MOLT", "expected_usd": 10, "onchain_usd": 9.8, "discrepancy_pct": 2, "status": "pass/fail"}
- Failures → data/verifier_alarms.jsonl (append): {"ts": "iso", "alarms": ["MOLT: -2% drift"]}

Wallet: os.getenv('BASE_WALLET')
Basescan: https://api.basescan.org/api?module=account&action=tokenbalance&contractaddress={address}&address={wallet}&tag=latest&apikey={BASESCAN_API_KEY}
No existing verifier.py.

Handle empty positions.json (no open positions → pass).

userStories.title: scripts/telegram_verifier.py — Telegram escalation on failure
userStories.description:
Current state: data/verifier_alarms.jsonl from US-022.

Build scripts/telegram_verifier.py:
- tail -n 10 data/verifier_alarms.jsonl
- If alarms exist: format '🚨 VERIFIER ALARM: [last_alarm]' → message tool (channel=telegram, target=@jill_agent2_bot or chat_id from env)
- Run after verifier.py (--dry-run flag skips message).

Import scanner.message_alert() if exists, else direct OpenClaw message tool.

userStories.title: scripts/run-verifier.sh + plist — daily cron (06:00)
userStories.description:
Current state: none.

1. scripts/run-verifier.sh:
#!/bin/bash
cd /Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader
python3 scripts/verifier.py
python3 scripts/telegram_verifier.py

chmod +x

2. data/com.crestview.verifier.plist:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key>
  <string>com.crestview.verifier</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/run-verifier.sh</string>
  </array>
  <key>StartInterval</key>
  <integer>86400</integer>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key>
  <true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key>
  <true/>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key>
  <string>/Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/data/verifier.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key>
  <string>/Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/data/verifier.log</string>
</dict>
</plist>

User: cp ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl load.
acceptanceCriteria: test -f data/com.crestview.verifier.plist && plutil -lint data/com.crestview.verifier.plist | head -1 | grep OK
